blurb: Everyone on this street lives above the shop they queue in.
name: the Marrow
signature: A shutter goes up somewhere down the row, then another, in no hurry.
Somebody’s radio leaks from a window two floors up, and nobody looks.
Frying oil and drain water braid together the length of the pavement.
A price is chalked on a board, rubbed out, and chalked again a little higher.
skyline: the shutters of Marrow Street run off into the haze
